2607.24368.title: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory
2607.24368.paper_summary: Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association blind spot and introduce InMind, a 125-task, expert-verified benchmark spanning ten life domains, with 113 tasks grounded in citable public sources. Its paired controls separate three explanations that existing evaluations conflate: the fact was never stored, the model lacks the bridging knowledge, or the fact was stored and never surfaced. The verdict is clean. With the decisive memory placed in context, the backbone answers 84.0 percent of indirect queries; when the same memory must be retrieved, six vector, graph, and agentic memory systems reach at most 14.4 percent, even though they recall the same facts on demand at up to 100 percent. An embedding with eight times the dimensionality raises answer-blind target recall for every system yet leaves the gap essentially intact. A minimal diagnostic probe that keeps memory visible before the query arrives recovers most of the gap, locating the failure in the query-conditioned interface itself and pointing to routing, deciding which facts must stay visible, as the open problem InMind is built to score.
2607.24368.paper_summary_zh: 長期記憶系統將用戶所說的內容存儲在外部存儲中，並在相關查詢到達時檢索它。這個介面基於一個如此自然的假設，以至於很少被明言：需要的記憶將與需要它的查詢相似。世界知識打破了這一假設。樹堅果過敏應該改變對馬卡龍請求的回答，因為它們的杏仁粉成分，但這兩個文本之間沒有檢索者可以看到的線索。我們將這種失敗模式稱為隱性聯想盲點，並介紹InMind，這是一個涵蓋十個生活領域的125項任務、經專家驗證的基準，其中113項任務基於可引用的公共來源。其配對控制分離了現有評估所混淆的三個解釋：事實從未被存儲、模型缺乏橋接知識，或事實已被存儲但從未顯現。判決是明確的。在決定性的記憶置於上下文中時，主幹回答84.0%的間接查詢；當相同的記憶必須被檢索時，六個向量、圖形和主動記憶系統的回應率最多只有14.4%，儘管它們在需求時可以回憶出高達100%的相同事實。一個具有八倍維度的嵌入提高了每個系統的答案盲目目標回憶，但基本上保持了差距不變。一個在查詢到達之前保持記憶可見的最小診斷探針恢復了大部分差距，將失敗定位於查詢條件介面本身，並指向路由，決定哪些事實必須保持可見，這是InMind旨在評分的開放問題。
